title: 第11章 风云雷闪第12章 敌踪
content_zh:
四个人站在帐中。
两男两女，年纪相仿，都是二十出头的样子。
站在最前面的是大哥，叫风暴。人如其名，眉眼间带着一股子压不住的劲，肩膀很宽，站得很直，像一棵长在山崖上的松树。他的手很长，垂在身侧，手指微微握着，握得很松，但骨节分明，像随时能握成拳头。
他身后站着三个人。
左边是二妹云彩。她很瘦，瘦得像一根竹竿，穿一件灰布衣裳，衣裳洗得很旧，袖口磨出了毛边。她的脸很小，下巴很尖，眼睛不大，但很亮，亮得像两颗钉在水里的星。她站在风暴身后半步的位置，既不靠前也不靠后，刚好能把另外两个人都看在眼里。
右边是三弟雷霆。他比风暴矮半个头，比云彩壮一倍，浑身像是用铁打出来的，胳膊上的肌肉像盘着的蛇。他的眼睛圆，圆得像铜铃，瞪着看人的时候，像要把人瞪出两个洞来。
最后面是四妹闪电。她最小，也最瘦，瘦得像一片叶子，站都站不稳似的。但她的眼睛很活，活得像水银，转来转去，什么都看，什么都记。她的手很小，放在腰边，偶尔动一下，动得很快，快得看不清。
四个人的兵器很特别。
不是刀，不是剑，是锏。
锏有四种，长短不一。
风暴用的是长锏，有齐眉高，铜身铁心，锏身刻着很粗的纹路，像是风刮过的痕迹。
云彩用的是中锏，到胸口长，比风暴的短一截，但更细，锏尾系着一根很细的红绳。
雷霆和闪电用的是短锏，只有一尺长，两只手各握一把，握得很紧。
四种锏，四种打法，配合在一起，天衣无缝。
肖琪坐在案几后面，看着他们。
他没有立刻开口。
他只是看着。
看着这四个人。
他的目光从风暴开始，移到云彩，移到雷霆，移到闪电，然后又回到风暴。
看了很久。

帐中很安静。
安静得能听见帐外的风声，能听见远处有人在喊口令，能听见云彩的呼吸声。
她呼吸有点急，像是绷着一根弦。
肖琪看出来了。
“这就是你们？“他开口。
声音不大，但很稳。
风暴往前走了一步。
“是。“他说，声音很平。
他的声音有一种很重的分量，像石头砸在地上。
“从哪儿来的？“
“江湖。“
“跟谁学的手艺？“
风暴没有回答。
他只是站在那里，抱着那根齐眉高的长锏，看着肖琪。
他的眼睛很冷，冷得像两块冰。
那种冷不是刻意装出来的，是常年在江湖上飘的人特有的冷。见过太多的人，见过太多的事，冷成了习惯，冷成了本能。
肖琪看着他，盯了一会儿。
“你不想说？“
“不重要。“风暴说，“能打仗就行。“
肖琪看着他，盯了很久。

久到帐中的空气都好像凝住了。
久到雷霆的眼睛开始瞪。
他瞪着肖琪，瞪得很用力。
云彩的手微微动了一下，像是要去拉他，但又收了回去。
肖琪看见了。
content_en:
Four people stood in the tent.
Two men and two women, similar in age, both in their early twenties.
Standing at the front is the eldest brother, named Storm. As his name suggests, he has an irrepressible energy between his eyebrows and eyes, his shoulders are very broad, and he stands upright, like a pine tree growing on the cliff. His hands were very long, hanging down by his sides, and his fingers were slightly clenched, loosely, but with clear joints, as if they could be made into fists at any time.
There were three people standing behind him.
On the left is the second sister Yuncai. She is very thin, as thin as a bamboo pole. She wears a gray cloth dress. The dress is very old after washing, and the cuffs are frayed. Her face is small, her chin is pointed, and her eyes are not big but very bright, as bright as two stars nailed in the water. She stood half a step behind the storm, neither in front nor behind, just enough to see the other two people.
On the right is the third brother Lei Ting. He was half a head shorter than the storm and twice as strong as the clouds. His whole body seemed to be made of iron, and the muscles on his arms were like coiled snakes. His eyes were round, as round as copper bells, and when he stared at people, it seemed as if they were going to make two holes in them.
At the end is the fourth sister Lightning. She was the youngest and thinnest, as thin as a leaf and could not stand firmly. But her eyes are very lively, as lively as mercury, spinning around, seeing and remembering everything. Her hands were small, placed on her waist, and occasionally moved, too fast to be seen clearly.
The weapons of the four people are very special.
Not a knife, not a sword, but a mace.
There are four kinds of maces, varying in length.
The mace used by Feng Feng was as high as his eyebrows, with a copper body and an iron core. The mace's body was engraved with thick lines, like traces of wind.
Yuncai uses a medium mace, which is as long as the chest, shorter than Storm's, but thinner. There is a very thin red rope tied to the end of the mace.
Thunder and Lightning used short maces, only one foot long. They held one in each hand and held it tightly.
Four tricks, four ways of playing, all working together to create a perfect match.
Xiao Qi sat behind the desk and looked at them.
He didn't speak immediately.
He just watched.
Look at these four people.
His eyes started from the storm, moved to the clouds, to the thunder, to the lightning, and then back to the storm.
I watched it for a long time.
It was quiet in the tent.
It was so quiet that you could hear the wind outside the tent, you could hear someone shouting commands in the distance, and you could hear the breathing of the clouds.
Her breathing was a little rapid, as if she was holding a string.
Xiao Qi saw it.
"Is this you?" he asked.
It's not loud, but it's stable.
Storm took a step forward.
"Yes." He said, his voice was calm.
His voice had a heavy weight, like a stone hitting the ground.
"Where did it come from?"
"Jianghu."
"Who did you learn this craft from?"
Storm didn't answer.
He just stood there, holding the mace as high as his eyebrows, looking at Xiao Qi.
His eyes were cold, as cold as two pieces of ice.
That kind of coldness is not deliberately pretended, it is the unique coldness of people who have been floating in the rivers and lakes all year round. I have seen too many people and too many things. Coldness has become a habit and instinct.
Xiao Qi looked at him for a while.
"You don't want to say it?"
"It doesn't matter." Storm said, "As long as you can fight."
Xiao Qi looked at him for a long time.
The air in the tent seemed to be frozen for a long time.
It took so long that Lei Lei's eyes started to stare.
He stared at Xiao Qi very hard.
Yuncai's hand moved slightly, as if to pull him, but he took it back.
Xiao Qi saw it.
